results.title: Dafne y Pol
results.overview: Dafne and Clara are two classmates who endure harassment at school because of their sexual orientation. Clara tries to stand up to her classmates' homophobic remarks by treating her relationship with Dafne as something completely normal.

results.title: NYRA II
results.overview: Trapped in a series of looping dream timelines, Nyra is hunted by an unknown killer and must find a way to escape before the cycles consume her.

results.title: The Dance of the Kokorrdit
results.overview: A Wounaan teenager and a leader of their community venture into the Darién in search of a sacred bird. Along the way, they will face the dangers that threaten their territory and their culture.

results.title: Damilola Taylor: The Untold Story
results.overview: Ten-year-old Damilola Taylor was fatally stabbed in 2000 in a stairwell in Peckham, South East London, just metres from his home. 'Star Wars' star John Boyega, who also grew up in Peckham, speaks for the first time about being one of the last people to see him alive, sharing the fear and uncertainty that followed in the aftermath of Taylor's death. Boyega is joined by close friends and family members of Taylor, who reveal the events that led to his death and talk for the first time about the impact his tragic murder has had in shaping their lives.

results.title: The Bridge
results.overview: Young Israeli survivors of the October 7 attacks travel to Los Angeles for Rock ’n’ Roll Fantasy Camp, discovering healing and strength through music and shared resilience.

results.title: Joqueta
results.overview: Filipa, a young jockey whose talent remains undiscovered, lives in her brother's shadow until she has to step in for him in a race after he is injured, finally getting the chance to show who she really is.

results.title: Matchbox the Movie
results.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

results.title: Cow Farm
results.overview: In a world that farms women's bodies for profit, one woman's trauma awakens the Huldra and a commune of women decide to burn the whole system down.

results.title: Searching for Afunakwa
results.overview: Searching for Afunakwa is a documentary that traces the story behind one of the most recognisable pieces of 'world music' of the 1990s – "Sweet Lullaby" by Deep Forest. It looks back to the song’s origins in a remote village in the Solomon Islands and follows its journey into the 1990s music industry and a renewed life in the YouTube era. At its heart, it explores Afunakwa, the singer behind the original recording, and the Baegu, the people from which the song came.

results.title: Que te sirva para remedios
results.overview: Argentine feature film, directed by Georgina Zanardi, duration: 1:15:00.

results.title: The Spot
results.overview: A wrestler is on the way to the top of the company and is facing the champion but gets injured in the match and is forced to take time off. Along the way the wrestler deals with being away from the ring, losing confidence and missing wrestling while he discovers the champion intentionally injured him due to jealousy and not wanting to lose the top spot. Eventually, the wrestler makes his comeback to ring months later against the same champion for the title and the top spot.

results.title: Oh! I’ve Caught the Sun Atom. Oleg Tabakov
results.original_title: О! Поймал Атом Солнца. Олег Табаков
results.overview: Through the living testimonies of colleagues, students, and unique archival materials, the film reveals Tabakov’s path as an actor, teacher, artistic director, reformer of the theatrical process, and tireless creator. The film is built on associative drama, where the metaphor of the “atom of the sun” takes on particular significance — as a spark, as the inner energy that Tabakov carried within himself and that he knew how to inspire in others.

results.title: Deadly Revision
results.overview: Udin is a creative worker in the field of graphic designer who is pressured by his client named Tina, a young politician who demands many things from Udin. However, Udin felt helpless with Tina's demands because he still wanted to get the next service projects. So Udin had to be forced to do what TIna wanted.

results.title: “Red”
results.overview: he wakes up with fresh blood on his hands and runs straight into the daylight to put distance between himself and what he's done. but the streets are empty, nobody is chasing him, and every direction leads right back to his own bathroom mirror. standing under the shower, watching the red-tainted water circle down the drain, he's stuck in a cold cycle of panic, blood, and doing it all over again.

results.title: Mischief and Obedience
results.overview: When a reformed troublemaker reunites with his reckless high school best friend at the luxury hotel where he works, their attempt to save his career turns into a disastrous reminder that old habits die hard.

results.title: Dirty Dose
results.overview: Trapped in an endless routine, a forensic medical examiner spirals into heroin addiction and becomes a victim of illegal organ trafficking. Losing her grip on reality, she begins hunting a mysterious man who may have destroyed her life.

results.title: Our Struggle
results.overview: A couple of time travelers break into a debate over killing history’s greatest monster in infant form; a chaotic living room chase causes them to reconsider their objective.
